problem_statement: Node's path module is imported directly across all tool files, leading to infrastructure bleed and duplicate backslash-to-slash replacement routines for Windows compatibility.
constraints: Relative calculations must always map Windows '\' to POSIX '/' slashes

risk_register.risk: Breaking custom win32 separator checks in tools like calculate-hash.
risk_register.mitigation: Review how calculate-hash uses win32 and ensure PathFormatter.relative is functionally identical.

next_steps: Create src/core/path-formatter.ts containing the PathFormatter implementation.
Replace node:path imports with PathFormatter in all 11 tool files.
Run type check and unit tests to ensure no regressions.
